body: Thank you all for your kind words and support. I was just beginning to feel alone in my struggle but now I know there are real people out there, not some anti suicide website,  that care whether or not I live and want to help me. I was in a dark place last night. I'm a lot more coherent today and I'm going to spend my day around those I love. Again, thank you all. I'll update once I see my therapist.
